segments.text: [00:00:02] Five amazing Isha life products that you should try. Now, before I start talking about Sadhguru's Isha life products, I want to make this clear that this video is not sponsored by Isha life. Nor do I have any kind of relation or association with them. I am just like you, a consumer looking to buy genuine and value for money products for me and my [00:00:17] family. So, without any further delay, let's get started. Hello friends, welcome to Fituber. Sadhguru Jaggi Vasudev, a well-known spiritual leader of India, has a wide range of products to offer under the brand name Isha life. From food products [00:00:33] to cosmetics to yoga accessories and home decor, Isha life has 100 plus products. Out of all these products, I have chosen five products which, in my opinion, are genuine, high in utility and value for money. Starting with number five on the list is Isha Sanjeevini instant health drink. Making [00:00:49] a kid drink plain milk can be quite a task. That's where health drinks come into picture, which not only make milk more palatable, but also promise to boost the nutrition. So, if you're looking for a genuine health drink, this is it. But, what is the problem with Bournvita? Well, the answer lies in [00:01:05] their ingredients. Where Isha Sanjeevini is made from multi-grains, pulses, spices without the use of preservatives, additives, or artificial flavors, Bournvita's so-called inner strength formula is a mere mix of refined sugars, malt, preservatives, additives, and [00:01:20] artificial flavors. one serving of Bournvita, you get almost three teaspoons of refined sugar. And why just bash Bournvita? You take any so-called health drink in the Indian market, be it Complan or like Milo or even Patanjali's Power Vita, they all are nothing but [00:01:36] sugar boxes covered with big celebrity endorsements. Isha life's health drink, on the other hand, truly justifies the name Sanjeevini. The goodness of green gram, millets, and country sugar, which is nothing but jaggery powder, truly makes it worth adding in milk. This one product beats the whole category of [00:01:52] mainstream health drinks by a mile. What's commendable is that even after using such quality ingredients, they have been successful in keeping the price quite competitive. Surely worth a try. Next on the list is Isha Life's purely natural face wash. While it is very easy to claim yourself natural, [00:02:08] herbal, and all that good stuff, but it is extremely difficult to live up to such tall claims. Himalaya's so-called purifying neem face wash is one such example. Leave aside a few herbal ingredients, this popular face wash has added synthetic colors and harsh preservatives which let alone prevent [00:02:25] pimples, it might actually damage the skin. On the other hand, Isha Life has surely gone the toxin-free way with this face wash as it has not even a single harsh chemical in it. Enriched with lemon and turmeric oil, this face wash might help you prevent pimples without causing any side effects. However, it is [00:02:42] to be noted that not all face washes made by Isha Life are toxin-free. For instance, their sandalwood face cleanser comes with added artificial fragrance and synthetic colors. Definitely not made in the Himalayas. But for this face cleanser, a big thumbs-up. Number three on the list is Isha's adai dosa mix. If [00:03:00] you are a dosa lover like me, this product will surely interest you. But why this one? Why not MTR's dosa mix which is much more popular and readily available? Again, the answer lies on the other side of the pack. Where Isha's dosa mix is made 100% from natural and [00:03:15] authentic dosa ingredients, even the salt used is rock salt. While MTR has conveniently added maida, refined vegetable oils, leavening agents, acidity regulator, and whatnot. MTR's original recipe is not so original. And do you know what's more interesting? [00:03:31] It's their price. You will get 500 g of MTR's dosa mix for 120 rupees, whereas Isha has managed to provide the same quantity of dosa mix 10 rupees cheaper. 06:38 - Fact #8 - There are emotions have an affinity with certain organs. This fact will help you understand how the daily emotions affect certain organs. You see, the mind and body connection is strong.
